answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, the "dawn" of Sybil resistance mechanisms arrives with the implementation of digital identity verification protocols. By utilizing a distributed ledger, agents can create a "grove" of interconnected identities, each with its unique digital footprint. This approach makes it difficult for attackers to create fake identities, as each new entity must be verified by the entire network, creating a "mirror" effect where no single agent can forge an identity without being detected.
